So when I hear a pitch, I'm usually one of the first people to get a pitch. And so usually it's, it's usually very, very bad. And then for even the best storytellers, they don't quite know where they are in the market and they don't quite know what is compelling to say yet.
Tiffany’s pitch really leaned on the product and the technology. But Maia and Elizabeth said that when you’re this early, the pitch needs to be anchored on the problem.
